summary: So I think the #prosocialweb has to deliberately design for diversity and inclusion. Let us recognize if we do not increase efforts around web literacy we will amplify the inequality of the past.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
So I think the #prosocialweb has to deliberately design for diversity and inclusion.

Let us recognize if we do not increase efforts around web literacy we will amplify the inequality of the past.
